date.as_written: śāke indugajā⟨‥⟩nanda indumite tapase site mande sūryatithau

notes: The scribe refers to himself anonymously as a dvija ('dvijo ʼlikham'). The era is designated as 'śāke' in the text, but the chronogram indu-gaja-[..]-nanda-indu yields 1981, which clearly corresponds to Vikrama Saṃvat (hence catalogued as ŚS(!) (VS)1981), since Śaka 1981 would correspond to 2059 CE.
